behavior: One tenant-scoped acquisition per invocation. The claim transaction commits before source/storage I/O; a separate transaction atomically inserts the immutable manifest and completes the fenced request.
binding: Canonical SHA-256 binds all validated request fields. Completion rejects snapshots without an identical acquisition_request_digest, including legacy snapshots. Existing manifests remain readable. Digest binding is provenance, not proof that a provider returned scientifically correct coordinates.
failure_policy: Expected adapter rejection, rights and payload failures yield sanitized ACQUISITION_REJECTED. Unexpected infrastructure errors propagate, leaving a durable lease recoverable after expiry. Stale publication rolls back the manifest insert. Content-addressed bytes may remain unreferenced after crashes; no automatic deletion is performed.
verified: Committed lease visible in a separate runtime-role transaction

deployment: Not bootstrapped or scheduled. HTTP submission remains disabled. No production database or object-store changes.
